derived_from.applied_state: 820 approved knowledge concepts after lecture-batch-38 opened the spring namespace from the first half of the spring introduction course.

overlap_analysis.finding: This file answers the question the previous one left open. Batch 38 named dependency injection only as the fix for a test seeing the wrong repository instance; here the container's own account of it arrives - what a bean is, how the scan finds one, and what is gained by registering it in java instead.
overlap_analysis.disposition: New subdomains spring.di and spring.db. Two candidates leave the spring namespace: the open-closed principle is a general software principle and is filed under software.principle beside the polymorphism concept it rests on. Three applied concepts gain evidence or edges - spring.web.static-content, whose lookup order is restated here from the other side, spring.arch.repository-interface, whose swap actually happens in this file, and db.transaction.application-transaction, which the test rollback is a use of.

update_authoring_note.statement: All three update candidates were generated mechanically from the applied notes, so every approved locator, alias, tag, path and edge is carried forward verbatim and only the new locator and edges are appended.

uncited_substantive_prose.detail: Downloading H2, chmod on its shell script, the JDBC URL to use the first time, the shell alias, the build file lines and the datasource properties including the version-specific note about a username that must be set. These are steps and version workarounds, not claims.

The course link, the running commentary of what is being built next, the deliberately-failing intermediate step whose lesson is stated in the cited span of the component scan, and the details wrappers around code listings.
